title: Unit Event — Dear Me, From Back Then — Episode6 The Start Of Our Solo Show

meta.Episode: Episode6 — The Start Of Our Solo Show
meta.Event Outline: The time has finally arrived for the first solo show of MORE MORE JUMP! Minori still can't seem to shake her nerves, but is reminded of the time she saw an ASRUN show for the first time after Haruka tells Minori a story about her own past...

rows.Line: Stage

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Oh, here's my seat...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: (I saw on the website that I'd be sitting pretty close to the stage, but this is better than I expected...!)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: (Still, it's their solo show... I sort of can't believe it.)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: (I've been a fan of Minori and MORE MORE JUMP! for pretty long now, but their big moment has finally arrived.)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I get to be here today. I need to cheer for them as much as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: I believe in you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
(Wait, those people over there...
Isn't that Nanamin and...? Mai?! But she used to be in ASRUN! Does that mean those seats for the invited guests?)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: (Most of the audience here seem pretty young, but I'm also seeing some more mature-looking people...)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
Oh, hang on...
What if they're here with their families...?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
It's been so long, Mai!
I didn't expect to get to meet you here today!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Not since we were on that show together as members of ASRUN. It's so nice to see you again!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Hehe. Likewise!
I heard that you've been doing some stage acting. It's great to hear that you're doing so well!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Still, this solo show atmosphere... I don't regret stepping away from being an idol, but this is so nostalgic. I guess I'm never going to not like this feeling.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
I sort of envy how they were able to build this from the ground up.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Idols have to deal with a lot, including sometimes not getting along with your fellow groupmates... It really isn't all fun and games.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Right. But everybody in MMJ seems to really believe in one another. It's so clear just by looking at them.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Which is why I can't help but root for them.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I totally get what you mean.
And it's beyond amazing how they were able to come this far without signing with an agency.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I have a feeling that this show's going become legendary and an opening chapter for MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree completely.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Let's wish them the best of luck!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: B-5... That will be in the section for invited guests. You'll find it straight ahead.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Oh, yes, here's row B.
Thank you very much. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: You're welcome! Please enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
Alright, we managed to safely move all the guests who were lined up for merchandise over here, so we should be good in terms of prep until the show starts.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (All that's left is for MORE MORE JUMP! to work their magic. How are we doing for time...?)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Perfect...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
...!
The lights...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: It's starting...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
Are you all ready to have some fun?!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Huh...? Aren't those...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're going to do everything we can to make sure you all enjoy today's show! Try to keep up, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is our very first solo show, so we want to make it a special memory for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: New outfits?!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Hey, aren't those the ones they made for their stream?!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
I knew they'd wear them today...
They're adorable! I can't believe I get to see all of this happen live!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, here comes our first song...
Let's all sing it together!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're so glad to see you all here today! Let's keep building up this energy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Together now!
Ready...?!
se_event_then_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: (I know I've been watching Minori closer than anybody else. I've never missed a stream, nor their Christmas event.)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
(But Minori seems like she's...
More than usual... No, more than any time I've ever seen her before, it's like she's really trying to draw in our attention today...)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: She's really shining...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They're all looking at me.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This feels completely different from our mini-concert. Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Minori!!
I've been waiting to see you again!!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I'm so happy I get to see you live!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can hear all of these people cheering for me...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Oh, but what about that other girl?
The amateur...

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
She seems so plain.
Like a normal person, you know?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Yeah, the other three alone seems like plenty. Why do they need her around?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Things didn't go well at all in the beginning, and I was told all these awful things... But it also made me realize that I just had to keep trying.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (After learning a lot from the others, as well as a lot of trial and error, I'm finally able to...)

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Minori! Please look this way!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Your new outfit's so cute!
It looks amazing on you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm finally able to, even just a little bit, actually say that I've become an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And it's all because...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Everyone!
We're just getting started here! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This is the moment I've been waiting for. My chance to put on the best show ever...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And people from all walks of life are here. Some may be going through some tough times, while others might be afraid of going after their dreams... Like the old me...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to spread hope to all of those people... Even if it's just a little bit, I want to inspire them to believe that tomorrow will be a better day.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Just like Haruka that day...
I want to tie us all together!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Such an incredible atmosphere.
The audience seems to be brimming with energy. But above all else...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Minori's totally on fire.
It's like she's burning even brighter than usual!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I guess she knows how to deliver when it counts?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'm not sure that's quite what's going on here...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, this feels more like...>

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Minori's grown so much...
She seemed pretty out of place at first since she didn't have any experience or name recognition as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: But she's an essential part of this group now. Plus, she's become a great dancer and singer.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I know she's been putting a lot of effort into all the streams, but she's probably also been doing a lot behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: That makes me really want to root for her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Exaggerating each move to make sure everyone here can see what you're doing. Making sure to look at each person in the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We taught her all of that during our training camp and to think she'd master it this quickly... I'm so proud.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As a result, they're all focused on Minori... However...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This show isn't just about her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I can still do more.
After all, I practiced and worked just as hard during our training camp.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's great to see Minori receiving so much attention since I'm also a big fan of hers.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I'm also an idol.
Which means I'm not about to let her hog all the glory.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: (We're still just getting started!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, this is just the beginning!
Try to keep up, you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Louder, everyone! Louder!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Until you lose your voices!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
What a roar...
Are there really only 700 people here...?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
I know, right?
It's kinda hard to tell just based on their streams, but they seem to have a ton of really passionate fans. Plus...
se_event_then_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: (Minori's carrying the others and making their performance as a whole just that much better. It's like she's giving it a huge boost of energy.)

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: It's amazing how well everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! works together.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: They really do. This show even reminds me of why I wanted to become an idol at all...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Yeah, same here...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: This show really might become a legendary performance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whew... We've really been putting the pedal to the metal until now. I can tell that all of you have been too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But you guys can do more, right...?
How much do you have left in the tank?!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Still good!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I wanna hear you sing more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like you all still have plenty of energy! But as much as we want to keep singing for you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The time for us to say goodbye is unfortunately near. This next song will be our last...

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Noooo!
se_event_then_2022_009

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But before we sing our last song, we'd like you all to hear how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're still a small idol group that's trying to get on its feet, and your support is what made this solo show a reality.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We tried to sing in a way today that shows our appreciation for all of you... I really hope it worked...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku Fan
rows.Line: It did, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
And I can clearly tell how you all feel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too.
Your smiles are so bright that they're almost blinding. You've really given us a ton of energy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, they really have!
We hardly ever get to see your faces since we mostly focus on doing streams...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But being able to sing with all of you while actually getting to see your sparkling expressions like this was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, some of you may already know that this is Minori's very first solo show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm sure this has been a really special moment for her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, how about it?
Wanna take this moment to hear how she feels?
se_event_then_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Tell us how you feel, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-A-Airi, no one told me about this...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. A prepared speech would be so boring. You gotta just do these sorts of things on the fly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, it doesn't have to completely make sense. Just tell us in your own words how you feel... We wanna hear the genuine Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How I feel? In my own words...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Minori! You can do it!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Yuina...? She's here...?)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: The way you shouted out to me during your last show stream gave me the courage to try harder for club. And just the other day, I was able to make a big contribution during a real match...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: That's why I want to return the favor, Minori. You helped me so I want to help you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll say it in my own words.
There's a lot that I want to tell everyone, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope you'll listen!
se_event_then_2022_012
